title: PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem, a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user's state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal, combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. translated_title: PreCoMem：面向自进化长期对话智能体的预测性认知记忆
translated_abstract: 长程对话智能体需要保持用户记忆的足够稳定性以支持个性化，同时能在用户真正发生变化时进行适应调整。现有记忆系统通常将每条观察都追加存储，或通过启发式规则覆盖旧条目，这使得瞬态噪声难以与真实的信念漂移区分开来。我们提出PreCoMem，一个受预测编码启发的记忆巩固框架，它将记忆表示为关于用户状态的置信度加权信念。其核心信号“有效惊异度”结合了语义偏差和矛盾证据，并在检索结果分散且不可靠时对该信号进行降权。基于有效惊异度，一个双阈值门控将每一轮对话映射到三种确定性更新之一：MAINTAIN（维持）强化得到支持的信念，PROFILE（画像）将模糊线索存储为低置信度假设，CORRECT（纠正）对被可靠反驳的事实进行软性衰减。PROFILE阶段作为一个显式的等待室（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: PreCoMem提出了一种受预测编码启发的记忆巩固框架，通过“有效惊异度”信号和双阈值门控机制将用户记忆表示为置信度加权的信念，从而在长期对话中平衡个性化记忆的稳定性与对用户真实变化的适应能力。
en_tdlr: PreCoMem introduces a predictive coding-inspired memory consolidation framework that represents user memories as confidence-weighted beliefs, using an Effective Surprisal signal and a two-threshold gate to balance memory stability for personalization with adaptation to genuine user changes in long-term dialogue.
